description: This file defines the 'virtual' CKEDITOR.commandDefinition class, outlining the structure and features of command objects used within the CKEditor editing environment. It primarily contains documentation and examples for command object properties and usage.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition
classes.description: A virtual class representing command definitions in CKEditor, illustrating properties like exec, canUndo, async, editorFocus, startDisabled, modes, and their defaults and usage examples.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition.prototype.exec
methods.description: Specifies the function to execute when the command runs, with parameters for the editor instance and optional data, returning a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition.prototype.canUndo
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the command should be integrated with undo/redo history, defaulting to true.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition.prototype.async
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the command operates asynchronously, affecting how completion and event firing are handled.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition.prototype.editorFocus
methods.description: Boolean dictating whether the command should focus the editor before execution, defaulting to true.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition.prototype.startDisabled
methods.description: Boolean that determines if the command starts disabled, defaulting to false.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition.prototype.modes
methods.description: Object specifying in which editor modes (like wysiwyg) the command can be executed, defaulting to { wysiwyg : 1 }.
